summary: Frontend-only unauthenticated regression testing completed for push-hook relocation to root layout. Web preview boots cleanly, signed-out redirect behavior still works, and no push-web runtime warnings/regressions were observed in this run.
action_items: Run authenticated native-device validation for register-on-startup path: confirm api.mobilePush.registerMobileDevice is called after login/app launch.
Run authenticated logout validation to confirm best-effort api.mobilePush.unregisterMobileDevice call executes with real token.
Run native token-rotation scenario (APNs/FCM token refresh) to verify addPushTokenListener re-registers backend token correctly.
Do on-device iOS/Android checks for permissions, background state, and terminated-app notification behavior (web preview cannot validate these).
critical_code_review_comments: usePushNotifications.web.ts correctly isolates web preview from native Expo notification modules; no web push-token registration warnings were seen in this run.
Global push hook mount in app/_layout.tsx is correctly positioned earlier than tabs layout, matching the requested lifecycle alignment.
Console still shows non-blocking deprecated style/API warnings (shadow/textShadow/pointerEvents and expo-av deprecation), but no blocking runtime errors from the push changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run intentionally avoided authenticated flows per request context. Verified only code-path alignment + unauthenticated web runtime stability. Important: URL '/(tabs)' is not a valid public route path and lands on not-found by design; use '/chats' (or other concrete tab routes) for redirect behavior checks.
rca_of_issue: No new blocking bug reproduced in scoped unauthenticated testing. One observed not-found state came from direct navigation to '/(tabs)', which is an Expo route-group segment, not a public URL path.
